Hi all, 

Come join the PHL Code Club on the first Monday of August as we kick off the month by taking a moment to smell the roses 🌹

Welcome back to the Still Growing Sessions. Co-hosted by Terrence J. Harris and George of the Garden, this intentional, open-air assembly is designed to pull you out of the digital noise and root you in community.
For our August session, we are stepping away from traditional panel formats to host a fully interwoven, interactive group conversation. We are bringing together sound therapy, botanical wellness, and collective dialogue to explore what it means to sustain our personal and shared growth.
